<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Project Haven: Theme Exploration</title><meta name="description" content="A studio readout after a month of exploration: three themes for a Gloomhaven style tactics game."><style>
@font-face{font-family:'HavenSans';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenSans';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenSans';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenBarlow';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenBarlow';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenCormorant';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenCormorant';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:500;font-style:italic;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenFraunces';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'HavenFraunces';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:500;font-style:italic;font-display:swap}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;font-family:'HavenSans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;background:#0B0C0F;color:#14161A;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}
:root{--sans:'HavenSans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--r:12px}
a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,h4,p,ol,ul,figure{margin:0}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
.art{background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;border-radius:var(--r);width:100%}
.art.sq{border-radius:0}
.k169{aspect-ratio:16/9}.k43{aspect-ratio:4/3}.k34{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.cap{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px}
.small{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;color:var(--accent)}
.eyebrow:before{content:"";width:32px;height:2px;background:currentColor;flex:none}

/* theme systems */
.t-p{--bg:#F6F4EE;--panel:#FFFFFF;--panel2:#ECE9E0;--text:#14161A;--muted:#575C66;--accent:#B5471B;--line:#D9D5C8;--display:'HavenSans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;--dw:700;--dls:-0.03em;--dtrans:none}
.t-s{--bg:#0A1118;--panel:#121E2A;--panel2:#192A3A;--text:#E8EEF3;--muted:#9FB3C3;--accent:#F2762E;--accent2:#4FD1E8;--line:#26394A;--display:'HavenBarlow','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--dw:700;--dls:0.02em;--dtrans:uppercase}
.t-r{--bg:#F3ECDA;--panel:#EADFC2;--panel2:#E1D3AE;--text:#1E2757;--muted:#4F5380;--accent:#8C6420;--accent2:#222B66;--line:#C9B98C;--display:'HavenCormorant',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--dw:600;--dls:0;--dtrans:none}
.t-t{--bg:#0E1A1D;--panel:#16282C;--panel2:#1E3639;--text:#E6E3D3;--muted:#9AABA4;--accent:#E8A33D;--accent2:#5FA89B;--line:#2C4A4B;--display:'HavenFraunces',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--dw:500;--dls:-0.01em;--dtrans:none}
.spread{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);padding:96px 0;position:relative}
.spread.cont{padding-top:0}
.sh{margin-bottom:48px;max-width:760px}
.sh h3,.sh h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);letter-spacing:var(--dls);text-transform:var(--dtrans);font-size:clamp(34px,4.4vw,58px);line-height:1.04;margin-top:16px}
.t-r .sh h3,.t-r .sh h2{font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,64px)}
.lead{font-size:clamp(19px,1.6vw,22px);line-height:1.5}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:start}
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;align-items:start}
.grid4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px;align-items:start}
.panel{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:24px}
.numl{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);font-size:44px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}

/* nav */
.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:#0B0C0F;color:#EDEDED;border-bottom:1px solid #22252B}
.nav .in{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;height:56px}
.nav b{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em;white-space:nowrap}
.nav ul{display:flex;gap:4px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;flex:1}
.nav ul::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;height:56px;padding:0 12px;font-size:14px;text-decoration:none;color:#B9BDC6;white-space:nowrap}
.nav a:hover{color:#fff}
section[id]{scroll-margin-top:56px}

/* cover */
.cover{background:#0B0C0F;color:#F2F2F0;padding:0;min-height:calc(100vh - 56px);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.cover .top{padding:88px 0 56px;flex:1}
.cover h1{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.04em;line-height:0.96;font-size:clamp(52px,9vw,128px);margin-top:28px}
.cover h1 span{display:block;color:#A9ADB6}
.cover .sub{max-width:640px;font-size:clamp(18px,1.7vw,22px);line-height:1.5;color:#C9CCD3;margin-top:32px}
.cover .meta{margin-top:32px;font-size:14px;color:#8B909A}
.cover .eyebrow{color:#E7A92B}
.tri{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0}
.tri .p{background:#0B0C0F}
.tri .art{border-radius:0;aspect-ratio:4/3}
.tri .lab{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 24px;font-size:14px;border-top:1px solid #22252B}
.tri .lab b{font-weight:600;color:#F2F2F0}.tri .lab span{color:#8B909A}

/* contents */
.contents ol{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:64px}
.contents li a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;min-height:72px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.contents li a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.contents li i{font-style:normal;font-size:14px;color:var(--accent);width:28px;font-weight:600}
.contents li span{font-weight:400;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;text-align:right}

/* brief */
.cards3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px}
.tcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.tcard h4{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15}
.tcard .k{font-size:14px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.rec{background:#14161A;color:#F2F2F0;border-radius:var(--r);padding:32px}
.rec .eyebrow{color:#E7A92B}
.rec p{margin-top:16px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.55;color:#E4E4E0}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:32px;list-style:none;padding:0}
.steps li{border-top:2px solid var(--text);padding-top:16px}
.steps b{display:block;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:8px}
.steps span{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);display:block}

/* tables */
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}
th{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--text);vertical-align:middle}
td{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
td:first-child{font-weight:600}
td a{text-underline-offset:3px}
.tbl{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel)}
.tbl th{background:transparent}

/* thrown away */
.away{list-style:none;padding:0}
.away li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr auto;gap:32px;align-items:center;padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.away b{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:28px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.pill.hi{color:#fff;background:#B3261E;border-color:#B3261E}
.pill.md{color:#14161A;background:#F1C14A;border-color:#F1C14A}

/* space case */
.swap{font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,30px);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-weight:600}
.ex{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:32px}
.ex .panel b{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:8px}
.ex .panel p{font-size:15px}
.pc h4{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px}
.pc ul{padding:0;margin:0 0 32px;list-style:none}
.pc li{position:relative;padding-left:24px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.pc li:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:10px;width:10px;height:2px;background:var(--accent)}

/* dossier pieces */
.opener{padding:0 0 88px}
.cine{aspect-ratio:1280/470;border-radius:0;min-height:260px}
.opener .body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:64px;margin-top:56px;align-items:start}
.opener h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);text-transform:var(--dtrans);letter-spacing:var(--dls);font-size:clamp(52px,8vw,112px);line-height:.92;margin:16px 0 24px}
.t-r .opener h2{font-size:clamp(56px,8.6vw,124px)}
.opener .tone{margin-top:20px;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.opener .tone b{color:var(--text)}
.pillars{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;gap:0}
.pillars li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pillars li:first-child{border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}
.pillars b{display:block;font-size:19px;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:6px}
.pillars span{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);display:block}
.pillars .numl{font-size:32px}
.rules{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 340px;gap:40px;align-items:start}
.rules table{font-size:14px}
.rules td,.rules th{padding:11px 14px}
.reqs{list-style:none;padding:0}
.reqs li{padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.reqs li:first-child{border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}
.reqs b{display:block;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:4px}
.reqs span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);display:block}
.mapspread{padding:0}
.mapcap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:64px;padding:48px 0 72px;align-items:start}
.mapcap h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);text-transform:var(--dtrans);letter-spacing:var(--dls);font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);line-height:1.04;margin-top:16px}
.mapcap dl{margin:0;display:grid;gap:16px}
.mapcap dt{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent)}
.mapcap dd{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:15px}
.diagram{position:relative;width:100%;container-type:inline-size;color:var(--accent)}
.diagram svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.diagram path{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;opacity:.8}
.diagram path.dash{stroke-dasharray:7 7}
.diagram marker path{fill:currentColor;stroke:none;opacity:1}
.diagram .elabel{fill:var(--muted);font-size:15px;font-family:var(--sans)}
.dnode{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:4px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:8px;padding:0 1.1cqw;overflow:hidden;color:var(--text)}
.dnode.dec{border-left-width:1px;border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--panel2)}
.dnode b{font-size:clamp(11px,1.35cqw,16px);line-height:1.2}
.dnode span{font-size:clamp(10px,1.12cqw,13.5px);line-height:1.3;color:var(--muted)}
.dlist{display:none;list-style:none;padding:0}
.dlist li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.dlist .rk{font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
.dlist p{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px}
.lvls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px}
.lvls p.note{margin-top:16px;font-size:15px}
.uiwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:32px}
.notes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px}
.mock-scroll{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:var(--r)}
.mock{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;min-width:640px;border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;background:#000}
.mock .art{position:absolute;inset:0;height:100%;border-radius:0}
.mock .top,.mock .bot{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;line-height:0}
.mock .top{top:0}.mock .bot{bottom:0}
.mock svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.notes{list-style:none;padding:0}
.notes li{padding:16px 0;border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}
.notes b{display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:16px}
.notes span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);display:block}
.hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.hero .art{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.hero .n{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent)}
.hero h4{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);text-transform:var(--dtrans);letter-spacing:var(--dls);font-size:30px;line-height:1.05}
.hero .role{font-size:15px}
.hero .sig{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px}
.hero .sig b{color:var(--text)}
.foes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:start}
.foe{padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.foe:first-child{border-top:2px solid var(--accent);padding-top:20px}
.foe h4{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);text-transform:var(--dtrans);letter-spacing:var(--dls);font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:6px}
.foe p{font-size:15px}
.foe p.b{color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.cardrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,340px)) 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.cardrow svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.28))}
.anat{list-style:none;padding:0}
.anat li{padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:15px}
.anat li:first-child{border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}
.anat b{display:inline}
.risks{list-style:none;padding:0}
.risks li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:32px;align-items:center;padding:22px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.risks b{display:block;font-size:19px;margin-bottom:4px}
.risks span{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);display:block}
.riskgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:start}
.pcpad{padding-top:72px}
.away .pill{justify-self:start}
.swipe{display:none}
.risks .pill{justify-self:start}
.oq h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 12px}
.oq ol{padding-left:20px;margin:0}
.oq li{margin-bottom:10px;font-size:15px}
.matrixwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,640px) 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.matrix{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;font-family:var(--sans)}
.matrix .mlabel{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;fill:var(--text)}
.matrix .maxis{font-size:13px;fill:var(--muted)}
.verdict{font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,30px);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-weight:600}
.legend{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:24px;list-style:none;padding:0;font-size:15px}
.legend li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.legend i{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
.recsteps{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;gap:0;counter-reset:s}
.recsteps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);counter-increment:s}
.recsteps li:before{content:counter(s);font-weight:700;font-size:28px;color:var(--accent);line-height:1}
.recsteps b{display:block;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:4px}
.recsteps span{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);display:block}
.qs{list-style:none;padding:0;counter-reset:q}
.qs li{counter-increment:q;display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr;gap:24px;padding:28px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);align-items:start;font-size:clamp(18px,1.7vw,22px);line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.qs li:before{content:counter(q);font-weight:700;font-size:40px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}
.sources{columns:2;column-gap:48px;list-style:none;padding:0;font-size:15px}
.sources li{break-inside:avoid;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.sources span{color:var(--muted)}
.foot{background:#0B0C0F;color:#8B909A;font-size:14px;padding:48px 0}

@media screen and (max-width:1000px){
 .dnode,.diagram svg{display:none}
 .diagram{display:none}.dlist{display:block}
 .grid2,.opener .body,.rules,.foes,.mapcap,.matrixwrap,.cardrow,.riskgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
 .pcpad{padding-top:0}
 .notes{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .grid4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .grid3,.cards3,.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .away li{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}
 .cardrow{justify-items:center}
 .cardrow>div:last-child{justify-self:stretch}
}
@media screen and (max-width:720px){
 body{font-size:16px}
 .wrap,.nav .in{padding:0 20px}
 .nav b{display:none}
 .spread{padding:64px 0}.opener{padding-bottom:64px}.spread.cont{padding-top:0}
 .cover .top{padding:56px 0 40px}
 .tri{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .tri .art{aspect-ratio:16/9}
 .grid3,.cards3,.steps,.grid4,.lvls,.ex{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .contents ol{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .contents li a{font-size:19px;min-height:60px}
 .contents li span{display:none}
 .sources{columns:1}
 .swipe{display:block;margin-top:8px}
 .cine{aspect-ratio:4/3}
 .hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42% 1fr;gap:4px 16px;align-items:center}
 .hero .art{grid-row:1 / span 4}
 .hero>*:not(.art){grid-column:2}
 table,thead,tbody,tr,td{display:block}
 thead{display:none}
 tr{padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
 td{border:0;padding:4px 0}
 td[data-l]:before{content:attr(data-l);display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px}
 td:first-child{font-size:17px}
 .qs li{grid-template-columns:40px 1fr;gap:12px}
 .qs li:before{font-size:30px}
 .risks li{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}
 .recsteps li,.pillars li{grid-template-columns:36px 1fr}
 .mapcap{padding:32px 0 48px}
}
@media print{
 @page{size:1280px 1040px;margin:0}
 html,body{background:#fff}
 .nav{display:none}
 .spread,.cover{height:1038px;min-height:0;break-after:page;break-inside:avoid-page;padding:56px 0;display:block;overflow:hidden}
 .spread.cont{padding-top:56px}
 .cover{display:flex;padding:0;height:1038px}
 .cover .top{padding:56px 0 24px}
 .cover h1{font-size:104px}
 .opener{padding:0 0 40px}
 .cine{aspect-ratio:1280/400}
 .opener .body{margin-top:40px}
 .mapspread .art{aspect-ratio:1280/620!important}
 .mapcap{padding:36px 0 48px}
 .rules td,.rules th{padding:8px 14px}
 .foot{display:none}
 .mock{min-width:0}
 .mock-scroll{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
 .notes{gap:24px}
 .uiwrap{gap:20px}
 *{animation:none!important}
}

.img-r_board{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}
.img-r_enemies{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}
.img-r_h1{background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,
